newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa plans extra Kazakhstan flight.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa plans extra Kazakhstan flight.

text.p: Deutsche Lufthansa AG plans to add a sixth weekly flight to Kazakhstan, the German transport ministry said.
The German airline already flies five times a week between Frankfurt and Almaty under a bilateral air accord between the two countries, a ministry statement added.
No timing was given for when the new service could be introduced.
Kazakhstan Airlines currently operates two weekly flights from Almaty to Frankfurt and two weekly charter flights to Hanover.
The German cabinet approved on Tuesday a bill to bring the bilateral accord signed between the two countries last March into German law, the ministry said.

Under the accord, each country grants the other the right to operate scheduled services, pick up passengers, cargo and post as well as use of air space. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
